name: v0.1.4 — Claude installer: fix OAuth-vs-gateway precedence
body:
v0.1.4 fixes the third-party gateway override silently being ignored when Claude has a cached `claude login` OAuth session.

## What changed

- Environment scan now detects `~/.claude/.credentials.json`
- A new task `清除 Anthropic 官方 OAuth 凭据` is added to the install plan when needed
- The credentials file is backed up to `.credentials.json.bak.<timestamp>` rather than hard-deleted
- `install_claude.sh` mirrors the same logic; pass `--keep-oauth` to opt out
- Plan / task labels updated

## Download

| 文件 | 类型 |
|---|---|
| `Claude-Installer-Portable-0.1.4.exe` | Claude · 便携 |
| `Claude-Installer-Setup-0.1.4.exe` | Claude · NSIS |

Codex 安装器仍是 0.1.2，未变。
